title: Mesh Embroidered Mermaid Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This one-shoulder mesh floral applique dress is designed to highlight both elegance and femininity. The delicate embroidery and jacquard-inspired textures create a refined layered look, while the puff sleeve softens the shoulder line, balancing allure and sophistication. The fitted bodice flows into a graceful A-line hem, flattering the waist and elongating the legs.

Perfect for weddings, cocktail receptions, or upscale evening parties, this dress offers a romantic yet modern touch. The floral applique adds dimension and artistry, making it an ideal choice for women who want to feel confident and beautiful while showcasing their natural curves.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Side right zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises mesh.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
